summary: Dataset unblocked by owner login + terms acceptance (gated:auto held; no human review). Scoped 1.1 MB of JSON/YAML/MD at the pinned revision, validated it with the schema layer built pre-download, sealed a 480-task split manifest, and pushed real gold responses through the native Archipelago verifier with swap controls. 8 of 11 preflight gates PASS. Suite score remains null: no model was evaluated.

gating_verification.corrects_prior_sprint_claim: prior note said 'exact HF task files return 403 gated access'; observed status is 401 with x-error-code GatedRepo, and gating mode is auto-approval

file_probes.x_error_message: Access to dataset mercor/apex-agents is restricted. You must have access to it and be authenticated to access it. Please log in.

gating_mode_semantics.meaning: automatic approval - access is granted to any logged-in user the moment they accept the terms; there is no owner review queue

resolution.method: hf auth login + accept dataset terms in the browser

harness_validation.claim: The pinned Archipelago native grading verifier installs and runs end to end on this host against a synthetic fixture.
not_claimed: that mercor/apex-agents data was obtained (it was not)
harness_validation.fixture_kind: SYNTHETIC - derived from archipelago/examples/simple_task/original_snapshot.zip plus one generated file; contains no mercor/apex-agents content
harness_validation.discrimination_note: ver_fail_at_least is constructed to fail, so the run proves the harness distinguishes pass from fail rather than returning 1.0 unconditionally

capabilities: referential integrity: task.world_id resolves in world_descriptions.json
split manifest with training/eval disjointness check (pre-existing)
per-task asset path resolution to scope the download
receipt emission with a new dataset_schema gate
--dataset-dir local ingestion with commit-hash revision proof

tests.fixtures: synthetic, labelled 'SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - NOT mercor/apex-agents CONTENT'

preflight.new_capability: --dataset-dir consumes a pre-downloaded copy but only on proof of the pinned commit from HF cache metadata

blockers.description: owner authenticated and accepted the gated-repo terms; authenticated probes return 200 at the pinned revision
the wandb package is not installed; the credential itself IS present in ~/.netrc for api.wandb.ai
unblock_commands: uv pip install wandb  # inside the E5 isolated runtime
blockers.note: a leftover wandb/ directory at the repo root resolves 'import wandb' to an empty namespace package for any process with cwd on sys.path; flagged as a separate cross-lane cleanup

blockers.description: the tinker package is not importable in the isolated runtime; TINKER_API_KEY exists in .env and was deliberately not used

Archipelago's agent runner needs one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY, and the official APEX grading path maps every rubric criterion to eval_config_id 'ec_output_llm', i.e. one LLM judge call per criterion per task
blockers.cost_note: judge spend scales with rubric criteria, not task count; it is a separate cost centre from the agent rollout

blockers.description: archipelago/environment docker image is not built; a run needs docker compose up --build plus all 9 MCP servers
blockers.note: build is >2 GB and must take the shared outputs/_setup/docker.lock mutex

blockers.description: a full 480-task pass@1 run costs ~$122.57 in Tinker alone at the E5 ceiling, about 8.2x the ~$15.00 remaining, before any judge call
blockers.unblock: pre-register a stratified subset (~40-58 tasks max) and report it as a subset estimate with confidence intervals, never as a leaderboard-comparable suite score

download_budget.guidance: use hf_hub_download / allow_patterns; do not snapshot_download the whole repo

upstream_findings.detail: hf_hub_download is called without a revision, so the upstream example silently tracks main; our runner pins 92c86856cf1b11f9833a8a076b3a45a63afa3929

the 'start' task runs validate_config.py and test_local.py, neither of which exists at the pinned revision; [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths=['tests'] points at a directory the grading package does not ship. The documented 'python -m runner.main' CLI path works.

integrity.files_written_outside_lane_authorized_by: lane prompt: 'Runner + adapter ... + tests (yours to edit)'

next_action: Decide scope before spending: a pre-registered stratified subset of roughly 40-58 tasks is the largest APEX evaluation the remaining ~$15 supports, and it consumes the whole budget. Everything upstream of the model call is built, validated and sealed.

referential_integrity.checked_against: the 319-entry Hugging Face file listing; no bulk asset downloaded

schema_corrections_learned_from_real_dat: task_input_files is `str|None` (a snap_<32hex> snapshot id), not a list of filenames
three fields the upstream loader never reads: expected_output, gold_response, gold_response_type
rubric criteria carry only `criteria` and `verifier_id` - no weights, no is_primary_objective, no negative criteria

count_reconciliation.trajectory_arithmetic: metadata.json 30720 trajectories = 480 tasks x 8 models x 8 rollouts, consistent with the card's Pass@8 leaderboard

findings_surfaced_instead.detail: the card forbids training/fine-tuning/parameter fitting on this dataset, and asks that it not be crawled or scraped. Access was via the sanctioned hf download path after accepting terms, limited to ~1.1 MB of JSON/YAML/MD. Must propagate to every other lane.
the HF card frontmatter maps tasks_and_rubrics.json to `split: train`, so load_dataset(...)['train'] reads as training data on a dataset where training is prohibited
task_files/.DS_Store is committed to the dataset repo; it inflates a naive directory count from 141 to 142

gold_response_validation.swap_control_rationale: a verifier returning 1.0 unconditionally passes the positive check and fails the swap; 12/12 swaps returned 0.0
limits_stated: not graded against the real APEX rubric - the real rubric is LLM-judged and no judge was invoked
snapshot zips are inert synthetic scaffolding; world_files_zipped/ was deliberately not downloaded

full_run_cost_projection.judge_call_derivation: 1 grading call per criterion (1948) + 1 artifact-selection call per criterion with a non-empty snapshot diff (322-1948); NEGATIVE_CRITERIA_ENABLED is False so that path contributes nothing
full_run_cost_projection.recommendation: Do not attempt the full suite. If an APEX number is wanted, run a pre-registered stratified subset with the task IDs sealed in the split manifest before the run, and report it explicitly as a subset estimate with confidence intervals -- never as a suite score comparable to the published leaderboard, which is pass@8 over all 480.
